description: Scoring-matrix plurality consensus of an alignment, identical to EMBOSS 6.6.0 'cons' (EDNAFULL for nucleotides, EBLOSUM62 for proteins; N/X where no residue reaches the plurality; lower case at or below setcase). Gaps '-', '.', '~' allowed. residueType 'auto' decides the type from the first sequence like cons; padRaggedRows pads shorter rows with trailing gaps like cons (ajSeqsetFill). Rows are read as EMBOSS reads an alignment (A4-3): letters and '*' are kept, '.' '~' '-' are gaps, '?' '#' '+' are the unknown residue, every other character (digits, blanks, '_', punctuation) is dropped, and rows that become unequal are padded with trailing gaps.

sequences.description: At least two aligned sequences (DNA or protein); equal length unless padRaggedRows.

residueType.description: Residue type: 'nucleotide' (default, EDNAFULL, no-consensus N), 'protein' (EBLOSUM62, no-consensus X) or 'auto' (decided from the first sequence as the cons program does).

plurality.description: Minimum positive-match weight for a consensus residue (cons -plurality); default half the total sequence weight.

identity.description: Required number of identical residues at a position (cons -identity, default 0 = off).

setcase.description: Positive-match weight at or below which the residue is written in lower case (cons -setcase); default half the total sequence weight.

weights.description: Optional per-sequence weights (one per sequence, finite, >= 0; default 1.0 each).

padRaggedRows.description: Pad rows shorter than the longest with trailing '-' gaps (cons ajSeqsetFill) instead of rejecting unequal lengths (default false).

consensus.description: Consensus sequence, one symbol per alignment column

errors.message: At least two sequences are required

examples.name: cons without a type flag, ragged rows
